# Mandarin Pathways

> Free Mandarin Chinese reference and self-study app, bilingual English/Indonesian. Animated stroke order for 2,978 HSK characters, complete HSK 1–9 word lists (HSK 3.0) and HSK 1–6 (HSK 2.0) with native audio, pinyin and tone guides, themed vocabulary, and a structured HSK 1 course with FSRS spaced repetition.

All reference pages are free and need no account. Content is original; stroke data comes from Hanzi Writer / Make Me a Hanzi, vocabulary from complete-hsk-vocabulary. The site is not affiliated with Hanban / Chinese Testing International.

## Reference

- [Character stroke order index](https://mandarinpathways.com/char): entry point to 2,978 per-character pages with animated stroke order, components, and example words
- [HSK word lists](https://mandarinpathways.com/hsk/1): levels 1–6 and 7–9, with audio and Indonesian/English meanings
- [Pinyin table](https://mandarinpathways.com/pinyin): every syllable, playable
- [Tones guide](https://mandarinpathways.com/tones): the four tones, tone pairs, and drills
- [Grammar](https://mandarinpathways.com/grammar) and [radicals](https://mandarinpathways.com/radicals) references

## Guides

- [Blog](https://mandarinpathways.com/blog): stroke order rules, tones, numbers, pinyin, and beginner guides (Indonesian and English)
- [Les Mandarin per kota](https://mandarinpathways.com/les-mandarin): choosing Mandarin lessons in 17 Indonesian cities — options, price ranges, and what each city's Chinese-language community actually speaks
- [Culture notes](https://mandarinpathways.com/culture) and [themed vocabulary](https://mandarinpathways.com/themes)

## About

- [About the site](https://mandarinpathways.com/about): author, sourcing, and limitations
